import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/specification_configuration")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
